observations: Photo 0 shows a beige 2-seater couch with rounded armrests and a low backrest, placed against a yellow wall on a tiled floor.
Photo 1 is a closer view of the same couch, showing the front and side profile. The fabric appears to be a light-colored, possibly off-white or cream, material with visible creases and minor stains.
The couch has a simple, modern design with no visible buttons or controls on the backrest.
No brand or model is visible on the couch in either photo.
The seller claims it is 'very neat' and a '2 seater couch'.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show minor stains and creases, but 'very neat' is subjective and not fully verifiable from the images alone.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, odors, or damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the fabric under direct light, especially in creases and seams, and a video showing the couch being touched or moved to check for stiffness or movement issues.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially stained or damaged, which reduces value

risks.risk: Material is not high-quality (e.g., low-grade vinyl or synthetic fabric)
risks.proof: A close-up of the fabric texture and a shot of the underside or back of the couch to check for stitching quality and material composition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-grade material, which reduces value

risks.risk: Couch is not in working condition (e.g., broken springs, loose cushions)
risks.proof: A video showing the couch being gently pushed and pulled to test for stability and cushion firmness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly not working, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up of the fabric texture and underside of the couch.
Video showing the couch being moved and pushed to test for stability and cushion firmness.
Photo of the backrest and any buttons or controls if present.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
